WITH date_dim_filtered AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT d_date_sk
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_year = 1998
),
customer_address_filtered AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT ca_address_sk, ca_state
    FROM customer_address
    WHERE ca_country = 'United States'
      AND ca_state IN ('NC', 'TX', 'IA', 'WI', 'WV', 'GA', 'OK', 'VA', 'KY')
),
web_returns_filtered AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT wr.wr_item_sk,
           wr.wr_order_number,
           wr.wr_refunded_cash,
           wr.wr_fee,
           r.r_reason_desc,
           cd1.cd_marital_status,
           cd1.cd_education_status,
           ca.ca_state
    FROM web_returns wr
    JOIN reason r ON wr.wr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
    JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT cd_demo_sk, cd_marital_status, cd_education_status
        FROM customer_demographics
        WHERE cd_demo_sk = wr.wr_refunded_cdemo_sk
          AND (
                (cd_marital_status = 'D' AND cd_education_status = 'Primary')
             OR (cd_marital_status = 'S' AND cd_education_status = 'College')
             OR (cd_marital_status = 'U' AND cd_education_status = 'Advanced Degree')
          )
    ) AS cd1 ON true
    JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT cd_demo_sk, cd_marital_status, cd_education_status
        FROM customer_demographics
        WHERE cd_demo_sk = wr.wr_returning_cdemo_sk
          AND cd_marital_status = cd1.cd_marital_status
          AND cd_education_status = cd1.cd_education_status
    ) AS cd2 ON true
    JOIN customer_address_filtered ca ON wr.wr_refunded_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
)
